approval.note: Every target in this file is a provisional engineering default. No accountable owner has approved any of them, and this file deliberately has no field that could record accountable sign-off. Approval is a business decision made outside this repository; until it is made, no report, page or alert may describe these as commitments.

objectives.title: Control-plane availability
objectives.sli: API requests that did not fail with a 5xx status, over all API requests (zenith_api_requests_total). 429 answers are the caller's own quota and count as served.

objectives.title: API latency (p95 under 500 ms)
objectives.sli: API requests answered within 500 ms, over all API requests (zenith_api_request_duration_seconds). A 95% target is the statement 'p95 is under 500 ms'.

objectives.title: Dispatch latency (p95 under 30 s)
objectives.sli: Operations that needed no human approval and started running within 30 s of being created, over all such operations that started (platform.operations created_at to started_at).

objectives.title: Workflow completion
objectives.sli: Operations that finished as succeeded, over operations that finished as succeeded, failed or uncertain (platform.operations). Failures caused by a tenant's own configuration are included: the indicator does not yet separate them.

objectives.title: Scheduler health
objectives.sli: Critical periodic jobs that are healthy (recent success, not failing) at each sample, over all critical jobs sampled (platform.scheduled_job_runs, PROD-OBS-04). Durable-only jobs that have never run are not sampled.

objectives.title: Sustained capacity
objectives.sli: Requests per second the capacity test (scripts/slo/capacity-test.mjs) sustained with p95 under 500 ms and an error rate of at most 0.5%. Measured on the machine that ran the test, not on a production topology.

objectives.title: Recovery point objective
objectives.sli: Seconds between the last data recovered by a restore rehearsal and the moment of the simulated failure.

objectives.title: Recovery time objective
objectives.sli: Seconds between the simulated failure and the moment a restore rehearsal reports the service answering again.
